## Window behavior

### Minimize and maximize buttons {#gnome-window-buttons}

GNOME only shows the close button by default

- **Handleiding:** [Applicaties]({{< relref "/docs/applications" >}})
- **Alleen op:** het GNOME-bureaublad
- **Label:** Aanbevolen
- **Bron:** [de regel](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L3360-L3368)

**Aanzetten**

```bash
# --- As you ---

# Show minimize and maximize buttons
gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.wm.preferences button-layout appmenu:minimize,maximize,close
```

**Uitzetten (het terugdraaien)**

```bash
# --- As you ---

# Reset the window button layout
gsettings reset org.gnome.desktop.wm.preferences button-layout
```

### New windows come to the front {#gnome-focus}

focus-new-windows 'smart'. Works best together with the Just Perfection extension

- **Handleiding:** [Applicaties]({{< relref "/docs/applications" >}})
- **Alleen op:** het GNOME-bureaublad
- **Label:** Aanbevolen
- **Bron:** [de regel](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L3369-L3380)

**Aanzetten**

```bash
# --- As you ---

# Let GNOME bring new windows to the front
gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.wm.preferences focus-new-windows smart
```

**Voor jou over na het aanvinken**

1. Also turn on 'Window Demands Attention Focus' in the Just Perfection extension (Behavior tab): the setting alone is not enough for apps without XDG Activation.

**Uitzetten (het terugdraaien)**

```bash
# --- As you ---

# Reset how new windows get focus
gsettings reset org.gnome.desktop.wm.preferences focus-new-windows
```

## Keyboard

### Windows-like shortcuts {#gnome-shortcuts}

Super+D, Shift+Super+S, Shift+Super+R, Super+I and Super+E

- **Handleiding:** [Applicaties]({{< relref "/docs/applications" >}})
- **Alleen op:** het GNOME-bureaublad
- **Bron:** [de regel](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L3381-L3384) · [`on_shortcuts`](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L1332-L1335) · [`off_shortcuts`](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L1338-L1341)

**Aanzetten**

```bash
# --- As you ---

# Super+D shows the desktop
gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.wm.keybindings show-desktop "['<Super>d']"

# Shift+Super+S takes a screenshot
gsettings set org.gnome.shell.keybindings show-screenshot-ui "['<Shift><Super>s']"

# Shift+Super+R records the screen
gsettings set org.gnome.shell.keybindings show-screen-recording-ui "['<Shift><Super>r']"

# Super+I opens Settings
gsettings set org.gnome.settings-daemon.plugins.media-keys control-center "['<Super>i']"

# Super+E opens the file manager
gsettings set org.gnome.settings-daemon.plugins.media-keys home "['<Super>e']"
```

**Uitzetten (het terugdraaien)**

```bash
# --- As you ---

# Reset: Super+D shows the desktop
gsettings reset org.gnome.desktop.wm.keybindings show-desktop

# Reset: Shift+Super+S takes a screenshot
gsettings reset org.gnome.shell.keybindings show-screenshot-ui

# Reset: Shift+Super+R records the screen
gsettings reset org.gnome.shell.keybindings show-screen-recording-ui

# Reset: Super+I opens Settings
gsettings reset org.gnome.settings-daemon.plugins.media-keys control-center

# Reset: Super+E opens the file manager
gsettings reset org.gnome.settings-daemon.plugins.media-keys home
```

### Copilot key opens the emoji picker {#gnome-smile-shortcut}

Uses the Copilot key as the shortcut for Smile

- **Handleiding:** [Utilities]({{< relref "/docs/applications/utilities" >}})
- **Vereist:** [Smile](../apps/#smile)
- **Alleen op:** het GNOME-bureaublad
- **Bron:** [de regel](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L3385-L3390) · [`on_smile_shortcut`](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L1362-L1374) · [`off_smile_shortcut`](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L1377-L1392)

Aanvinken vinkt ook aan wat het nodig heeft.

**Aanzetten**

```bash
# --- As you ---

# Shortcut for Smile: set its name
gsettings set org.gnome.settings-daemon.plugins.media-keys.custom-keybinding:/org/gnome/settings-daemon/plugins/media-keys/custom-keybindings/custom0/ name 'Emoji picker'

# Shortcut for Smile: set its command
gsettings set org.gnome.settings-daemon.plugins.media-keys.custom-keybinding:/org/gnome/settings-daemon/plugins/media-keys/custom-keybindings/custom0/ command 'flatpak run it.mijorus.smile'

# Shortcut for Smile: set its binding
gsettings set org.gnome.settings-daemon.plugins.media-keys.custom-keybinding:/org/gnome/settings-daemon/plugins/media-keys/custom-keybindings/custom0/ binding '<Shift><Super>F23'

# Shortcut for Smile: add it to the custom shortcuts
gsettings set org.gnome.settings-daemon.plugins.media-keys custom-keybindings "['/org/gnome/settings-daemon/plugins/media-keys/custom-keybindings/custom0/']"
```

**Voor jou over na het aanvinken**

1. If the key does not trigger Smile, set the shortcut yourself: Settings > Keyboard > Custom Shortcuts, command 'flatpak run it.mijorus.smile', then press the Copilot key.

**Uitzetten (het terugdraaien)**

```bash
# --- As you ---

# Remove the Copilot key shortcut for Smile
gsettings reset-recursively org.gnome.settings-daemon.plugins.media-keys.custom-keybinding:/org/gnome/settings-daemon/plugins/media-keys/custom-keybindings/custom0/

# Reset the list of custom shortcuts
gsettings reset org.gnome.settings-daemon.plugins.media-keys custom-keybindings
```

## Touchpad

### Touchpad scroll speed {#wsf}

wayland-scroll-factor: GNOME has no setting for it

- **Handleiding:** [Touchpad-scrollsnelheid]({{< relref "/docs/desktop/touchpad-scroll-speed" >}})
- **Alleen op:** het GNOME-bureaublad
- **Label:** Aanbevolen, `AUR`
- **Bron:** [de regel](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L3391-L3393) · [`on_wsf`](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L1667-L1677) · [`off_wsf`](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L1680-L1684)

**Aanzetten**

```bash
# --- As you, in a terminal window ---

# Install from the AUR: paru shows each PKGBUILD, and you read it before it builds
paru -S --needed wayland-scroll-factor

# --- As you ---

# Set the scroll factor to 0.2 (1.0 is the default speed)
wsf set 0.2

# Enable wayland-scroll-factor
wsf enable
```

- Opnieuw inloggen nodig: wayland-scroll-factor.

Uit de AUR, tenzij een repository die je gebruikt het pakket heeft: dan is het de `pacman`-regel.

**Uitzetten (het terugdraaien)**

```bash
# --- As you, first ---

# Switch wayland-scroll-factor off
wsf disable

# --- As root, one password prompt for all of it ---

# Remove packages, one at a time (one that something else still needs is kept)
pacman -Rs --noconfirm --noprogressbar wayland-scroll-factor
```

- Opnieuw inloggen nodig: switching wayland-scroll-factor off.

### Just Perfection {#ext-just-perfection}

Tweaks the shell. Its 'Window Demands Attention Focus' fixes apps that open in the background

- **Handleiding:** [Applicaties]({{< relref "/docs/applications" >}})
- **Alleen op:** het GNOME-bureaublad
- **Label:** Aanbevolen
- **Bron:** [de regel](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L1419-L1421) · [`extension_item`](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L1617-L1643) · [`install_extension`](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L1521-L1541) · [`remove_extension`](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L1544-L1553)

**Aanzetten**

```bash
# --- As you ---

# Install Just Perfection from extensions.gnome.org and switch it on
# quicksetup.py does this itself (install_extension), step by step:
curl -fsSL 'https://extensions.gnome.org/extension-info/?pk=3843&shell_version=<your GNOME Shell version>'
# ^ says which build of the extension fits your GNOME Shell, or that none does
curl -fsSL -o /home/your-username/.cache/zephyrus-setup/extensions/just-perfection-<build>.zip 'https://extensions.gnome.org/download-extension/just-perfection-desktop@just-perfection.shell-extension.zip?version_tag=<build>'
# ^ refused unless it is a zip with no path that leaves its folder, no symbolic link, at most 60 MB unpacked
#   and a metadata.json for just-perfection-desktop@just-perfection
gnome-extensions install --force /home/your-username/.cache/zephyrus-setup/extensions/just-perfection-<build>.zip
gsettings set org.gnome.shell enabled-extensions "[<what is switched on now>, 'just-perfection-desktop@just-perfection']"
gnome-extensions enable just-perfection-desktop@just-perfection
```

- Opnieuw inloggen nodig: Just Perfection (only if it does not show up by itself).

**Uitzetten (het terugdraaien)**

```bash
# --- As you ---

# Switch Just Perfection off and remove it
# quicksetup.py does this itself (remove_extension):
gsettings set org.gnome.shell enabled-extensions "[<what is switched on now, without 'just-perfection-desktop@just-perfection'>]"
gnome-extensions uninstall just-perfection-desktop@just-perfection
# ^ only for a copy in your home folder. When the shell does not answer, /home/your-username/.local/share/gnome-shell/extensions/just-perfection-desktop@just-perfection is deleted instead.
# An extension that came from a package is switched off, not removed.
```

- Settings of a removed extension stay in your home folder, so installing it again brings them back.

### Astra Monitor extras {#astra-monitor-deps}

- **Alleen op:** het GNOME-bureaublad
- **Bron:** [de regel](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L3399-L3402)

**Aanzetten**

```bash
# --- As root, one password prompt for all of it ---

# Install packages from the repositories
pacman -S --needed --noconfirm --noprogressbar libgtop amdgpu_top nethogs
```

**Uitzetten (het terugdraaien)**

```bash
# --- As root, one password prompt for all of it ---

# Remove packages, one at a time (one that something else still needs is kept)
pacman -Rs --noconfirm --noprogressbar amdgpu_top
pacman -Rs --noconfirm --noprogressbar nethogs
```

- Kept, because other things use them: libgtop
